segments.sn35.158:1.1: “Cakkhuṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha; cakkhāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha.
segments.sn35.158:1.2: Cakkhuṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, cakkhāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto cakkhusmimpi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.158:1.6: Sotaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha … ghānaṃ … jivhaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha;
segments.sn35.158:1.9: Jivhaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, jivhāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto jivhāyapi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.158:1.13: Kāyaṃ … manaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha;
segments.sn35.158:1.15: Manaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, manāniccatañca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto manasmimpi nibbindati.
